title: Easy Cross Faction confederation scripts
author: habus
description:
A small submod to allow Any Player Faction to get cross-faction confederation via Events with specific Lords

If any of the Lords is a vassal of the Player Faction for something between 20 to 25 Turns (Randomized value) an Event pops up to allow you to confederate, delay the decision or cancel it completly

To get them as vassal you can use the "All Diplomatic Options" (available via steam workshop: <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3032439976> )

Some Details:

-
The Katarin, Morathi, Yin-Yin and Fay Enchantress Mod uses a randomized Picture for the Event (will add more Pics for the other Packs in the future)

-
Morathi <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/23925-hiatus-lazys-morathi-ascension-stages-reskins/> gets her model changed to corruption stage 4 (since the AI can't do it and as far as i know a confederated Morathi also can't advance the corruption stages)

-
The Fay Enchantress <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/32476-%E5%A0%95%E8%90%BD%E6%B9%96%E7%A5%9E%E4%BB%99%E5%A5%B3-%E5%85%88%E8%A1%8C%E7%89%88-corruption-fay-early-access/> keeps her corruption mechanic after confederation

-
In case you use the Azazel's Realm Mod <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/27930-azazels-realm-miao-and-azazel-campaigns/>, you don't need the Katarin, Nkari and Azazel confed Mod (as far as i know) - they shouldnt break anything as long as you just dont confederate with them if the dilema pops up

-
also works with the miao seduce mod: <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/33808-corrupted-miao-ying-can-seduce/> (yeah, I know shameless self-promotion)

[[SPOILER]]

also some other small mod for Khalida:

tdw_khalida_switch_skin.pack:

-
small mod from the discord and even if it isnt a confed-script i leave it here as bonus

-
khalida gets her vanilla skin when she hasnt fought a battle for 5 turns - else she gets a buff for her Army and uses zetas Skin ("when Khalida goes to war Asaph regenerates her body to her living form")

-
Mod-Idea came from Azerty from the Discord

-
requires one of zetas Reskins for Khalida: <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/112>
